title: Attention and consciousness are separate processes

statements.text: Attention and consciousness are orthogonal. Attention strengthens visual representations and decides what reaches access, but it does not decide whether the visual functions that make up seeing are carried out.

sources.quote: A key element of RPT is that it regards attention and consciousness as separate (orthogonal) processes
Attention has well-documented effects on visual processing, but does not seem to affect whether particular visual functions are executed or not.
